Name: Valley Bros - Modify To i18n
Author: OSHIKAWA
Description:
I needed the i18n for "Valley Bros" to check my translation.


[size=3][b][color=#ffd966]///[/color][color=#ea9999]Caution:[/color][/b][color=#ffd966] THIS MOD NEEDS THE ORIGINAL MOD, [/color][color=#ffd966]TrashRacc's "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35106]Valley Bros[/url]". [/color][/size]


If you want to play "Valley Bros" with i18n, this mod will make your wish come true.
[color=#fff2cc][font=Verdana][i]** If you are looking for your translation file, check the " [b]Mods using this mod[/b]". **[/i][/font][/color]


[color=#a4c2f4][b][size=3]~ How to update [/size][/b][b]"Valley Bros" to i18n ~[/b][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install this original mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35106]Valley Bros[/url]" and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Install this mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Move the contents of "[CP] VALLEY BROS-ModifyTo_i18n" to the original mod "[CP] VALLEY BROS". (No need to move the .txt file.)[/*]
[*]All Overwrite.[/*]
[*]When the original mod includes the i18n file, it can work with i18n. You can use the default.json. [/*]
[*]And you can upload (your mother language).json on the Nexus as the translation file. No need for my permission, but you need to set your translation file to require the original mod, TrashRacc's "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35106]Valley Bros[/url]".[/*]
[*]GOOD LUCK. (｀･ω･´)[/*]
[/list]
[color=#b6d7a8]* [b][i]Tips for the translation[/i][/b]:[/color][color=#93c47d] If you play this mod with your language by overwriting the default.json, save the file using the i18n language code as the filename; this will prevent your language from being replaced with English when updating this mod.[/color]
[color=#a4c2f4]   (example) default.json -> mn.json[/color]
       [color=#6aa84f]By keeping a backup file named Locale Code (ex: mn) in the i18n folder,[/color]
[color=#6aa84f]       you can instantly revert default.json—which has been overwritten with English—back to your Mongolian language.[/color]
